name: John Seymour
summary: John Francis Seymour Jr. (December 3, 1937 – April 18, 2026) was an American politician who served as a United States senator from California from 1991 to 1992. A member of the Republican Party, he was appointed to continue Pete Wilson's term but lost the special election to finish it to Democratic nominee and former San Francisco mayor Dianne Feinstein.
